fichas.title: Trellises and climbing-plant supports
fichas.summary: Trellises and other supports are used to train climbing plants on walls and in gardens. Supports may be horizontal wires, wigwams, tents, or wire mesh. Wire spacing should suit the plant species; wall greening may also be subject to fire, ownership, building, and local regulations.
uses: Grow vegetables within reach for picking

dimensions.ocr_raw: Growth heights of 2–20 m are possible.
